blocks.text: MANILA – A Chinese national allegedly involved in a scheme to fraudulently obtain and use Filipino identification documents was arrested by Bureau of Immigration (BI) intelligence operatives. In a news release Monday, the BI identified the suspect as Yao Shucheng, 36, who also uses the Filipino alias King Agbulos, with a declared birth date of March 20, 1992. The suspect was arrested upon his arrival from Hanoi, Vietnam at the Ninoy Aquino International Airport (NAIA) Terminal 1 in Parañaque City on Sunday.
